title: 第三章：独行者
content_zh:
个人信息如下：
契约者13013号。(为保护猎杀者，此为虚假编号，任何手段无法锁定猎杀者。)
姓名；苏晓（猎杀者）
等级；lv.1。(一阶)。每10级为一阶，等级提升无任何属性加成，为猎杀者在‘乐园’内权限，与世界难度、任务难度等对应。）
生命值；100%。（此属性无法完全数据化，根据受伤程度而改变）
法力值；60。（智力x10，当前法力值恢复速度，每小时3点。）
力量：6 （攻击力、负重等相关）
敏捷：7 （移动、攻击速度等相关）
体力：5 （生命值、防御力、异常抗性等相互关）
智力：6 （法术伤害、法力值、感知等相关）
魅力：3 （社交、召唤等相关）
幸运：1 （物品开启、制造等相关，此属性极难提升，请猎杀者珍惜提升机会）
注：成年男性的标准属性为5点，幸运为1点。
杀戮天赋：噬灵者，杀死目标后，将会永久夺取1―15点法力值。
此天赋每个世界最多夺取100法力值。
【个人信息为方便猎杀者估测自身实力，与真正战斗力无关，属性值的高低会影响猎杀者的身体素质，但战斗并不只是身体素质决定，请猎杀者谨慎】
苏晓仔细查看几遍后，将他的个人属性记在心中。
他现在的等级是lv.1，等级的作用不必多说，相当于他在‘轮回乐园’中的权限。
他所进入的海贼王世界，难度等级是lv.6，而他的等级却只lv.1，这就说明了，他在海贼世界非常危险。
在一般情况下，‘轮回乐园’不会把契约者传送到高出五个等级的世界，这一切都与他‘猎杀者’的身份有关。

这所谓的‘猎杀者’身份，有什么好处苏晓还不得而知，但坏处却体现出来，那就是危险。
进入lv.6的世界，之后接下lv.3的任务，而他却只有lv.1，这‘游戏’的难度好像有点大。
而且根据‘轮回乐园’的介绍，他在今后的其他世界中，需要帮助‘轮回乐园’清除一些‘异常’的契约者。
这基本代表了，他与大部分契约者是先天的敌人，一同完成任务这种事，就算苏晓同意，其他契约者也不会同意。
一旦发现他的身份，只会群起而攻之。
谁能确定苏晓的猎杀任务中，没有他们的编号？
至于最上面标注的保护措施，苏晓对‘轮回乐园’都不怎么信任，更何况是‘轮回乐园’给出的保护？
但也不是没有好消息，他的各项属性都优于常人，这是他刻苦锻炼的成果。
虽然在海贼世界这种身体素质不算什么，但却给了他更高的起点。
苏晓的实力，绝不是各项属性表现出的这些，他还有一种特长，那就是他懂得如何去战斗，并且敢于战斗。
他虽然没有那种洞悉一切的智谋，但却有一颗不惧受伤或死亡的心，并不是他完全不怕，只是相比普通人，他的胆量更强，敢去做一些危险的事。
这一点，就是苏晓在‘轮回乐园’中闯荡的资本。
有时，一颗勇敢的心，远比强大的身体更为重要。
“那么，让我见识一下，这海贼的世界到底有多危险。”
苏晓矫健的前冲几步，脚踩窗沿的一角，纵身跃起，双臂上伸，抓住房顶的墙檐，之后双臂发力，将整个身体向上牵扯，上身从天花板的破洞处中探出。
就在苏晓准备查看外面的情况时，一声脆响传来。
“砰。”
是枪声，有些沉闷的枪声，苏晓马上做出判断。
将身体缩回墙壁后，双手紧扣墙檐，苏晓的头慢慢探出，查看外面的情况。
“砰、砰、砰……。”

爆豆般的枪声，在外面连成一片，经过苏晓的观察，这应该是‘废品终点站’的两伙势力在火拼。
双方各有几十人，正在中距离枪战。
苏晓的留意到，双方的衣物都十分破旧，而且面黄肌瘦，应该都是‘废品终点站’的流民。
“托比，这片地盘是我们的，你这是什么意思，大家都是‘拾荒’的可怜人，你难道想赶尽杀绝吗。”
枪身平息了一些，双方开始大声争吵。
“你的地盘？老子现在有十几把枪，这里以后就是老子说了算，等攒够了贝利，老子就带人出海，那时老子就是海贼了。
罗吉尔，放下武器，老子给你一个投靠的机……。”
托比话还没说完，就被一声枪响打断，感觉将头缩回到垃圾山后。
破旧房屋中的苏晓，刚好能看到说话那人，那是一位大胡子壮汉，正满脸狞笑的站在一堆垃圾后，看来并不是想接受对方的投降，而是要灭掉对方。
这名为托比的大胡子壮汉，与那些面黄肌瘦的流民不同，这家伙身材高大，全身肌肉扎结。
苏晓心中叹息一声，他终于体会lv.6的世界有多么危险。
如果他之前冒然出去，一定会被打成马蜂窝，而这只是开局，之后应该更加危险。
就在苏晓等待两伙人散去时，一道灵巧的身影，突然从房顶跃入到他所在的房屋中。
“呼~，好险，终于找到安全的……。”
来人话说到一半，就看到正攀附在墙壁上的苏晓。
“那个……。”
对方刚要说话，苏晓已经松开那紧扣墙檐的手，身体自由落下。
落地后，苏晓压低身体，脚下一蹬地面，几片枯叶飞溅而起，他犹如一只灵活的猎豹般扑向对方。
对方刚想解释些什么，但为时已晚。
苏晓先是一拳打在对方小腹上，他能明显感觉到，对方柔软的小腹被拳头顶的凹陷。

来人痛苦的弯下身，刚想惨叫出声，但苏晓的手掌，已经捂住对方的口鼻，只传出一声闷哼。
这还不算完，苏晓一手捂住对方的嘴，另一只手手掌平伸，手如利刃，指尖狠狠点在对方的胸口上。
“咚。”胸口被重击那种独有的闷响传来。
苏晓能感觉到对方的身体一软，眼中带着恐慌之色瘫软下去，只能发出轻声呢喃。
在指尖重击对方心脏位置时，苏晓感觉到十分柔软的触感。
“女人？”
他之所以这么做，是因为无法判断对方是敌是友，还是先制服好一些。
“不~，不要伤害我。”
犹若蚊蝇般轻细的声音传来，苏晓上下打量着来人。
参差不齐的黑色，脸上满是灰尘，但没被灰尘掩盖的脸颊非常白皙，亚麻色的衣服十分宽大，可以看出对方的身体很瘦弱，而且年龄不大。
“你是谁。”
对方的目的苏晓能猜出大概，应该是来避难。
“我叫米娅，我真的没有恶意，求你别伤害我。”米娅的声音很小。
心脏被重击，米娅没有昏迷已经算是体质很强，在短时间内，她都没有自由行动的能力。
“不许出声，否则杀了你。”
如果危及到生命危险，苏晓可是会杀人的，他还有血海深仇未报。
“咕噜。”
只有十五、六岁的米娅，咽了下口水。
“好，我只是想避难，不会出声。”
米娅突然感觉，和面前这个男人待在一起，并不比外面安全。

外面的枪声逐渐停息，乱战应该很快结束。
苏晓在等待，一旦外面的乱战结束，他会马上出去，虽然这样做很危险，但也同样是个机会，他很需要武器。
开局双手空空，不要说像样的武器，苏晓附近连一根木棍都没有。
(三七中文 et)
content_en:
Personal information is as follows:
Contractor No. 13013. (To protect the hunter, this is a false number, and the hunter cannot be locked by any means.)
Name; Su Xiao (Hunter)
Level; lv.1. (First order). Every 10 levels is a level. There is no attribute bonus when the level increases. It is the permission of the hunter in the "paradise", corresponding to the world difficulty, mission difficulty, etc. )
Health; 100%. (This attribute cannot be fully digitized and changes according to the degree of injury)
Mana; 60. (Intelligence x10, current mana recovery speed, 3 points per hour.)
Strength: 6 (related to attack power, weight, etc.)
Agility: 7 (related to movement, attack speed, etc.)
Physical strength: 5 (health, defense, abnormal resistance, etc. are related to each other)
Intelligence: 6 (related to spell damage, mana, perception, etc.)
Charisma: 3 (social, summoning, etc. related)
Luck: 1 (related to item opening, manufacturing, etc., this attribute is extremely difficult to improve, hunters should cherish the opportunity to improve)
Note: The standard attribute for an adult male is 5 points, and luck is 1 point.
Killing talent: Soul Eater, after killing the target, 1-15 mana points will be permanently taken away.
This talent can capture up to 100 mana per world.
[Personal information is for the convenience of hunters to estimate their own strength and has nothing to do with real combat effectiveness. The level of attribute values ​​will affect the physical fitness of hunters, but combat is not determined only by physical fitness, so hunters should be cautious]
After checking it carefully several times, Su Xiao kept his personal attributes in mind.
His current level is lv.1. Needless to say, the role of level is equivalent to his authority in the 'Reincarnation Paradise'.
The difficulty level of the One Piece world he entered is lv.6, but his level is only lv.1. This shows that he is very dangerous in the world of pirates.
Under normal circumstances, the 'Reincarnation Paradise' will not teleport the contractor to a world five levels higher. This is all related to his identity as a 'hunter'.
Su Xiao still doesn't know what the benefits of this so-called 'hunter' status are, but the disadvantages are obvious, that is, danger.
Entering the world of lv.6, and then taking on the task of lv.3, but he only has lv.1. This 'game' seems a bit difficult.
And according to the introduction of ‘Reincarnation Paradise’, he will need to help ‘Reincarnation Paradise’ eliminate some ‘abnormal’ contractors in other worlds in the future.
This basically means that he and most of the contractors are innate enemies. Even if Su Xiao agrees to complete a task together, other contractors will not agree.
Once his identity is discovered, they will only attack him in groups.
Who can confirm that Su Xiao's hunting mission did not include their numbers?
As for the protection measures marked on the top, Su Xiao doesn't have much trust in the 'Reincarnation Paradise', let alone the protection given by the 'Reincarnation Paradise'?
But it's not without good news. All his attributes are better than ordinary people. This is the result of his hard training.
Although this physical quality is nothing in the world of pirates, it gives him a higher starting point.
Su Xiao's strength is by no means reflected by various attributes. He also has a specialty, that is, he knows how to fight and dares to fight.
Although he does not have the intelligence to see through everything, he does have a heart that is not afraid of injury or death. It is not that he is not afraid at all, but he is more courageous than ordinary people and dares to do some dangerous things.
This is the capital that Su Xiao has in the 'Reincarnation Paradise'.
Sometimes, a brave heart is far more important than a strong body.
"Then, let me see how dangerous this world of pirates really is."
Su Xiao took a few steps forward vigorously, stepped on the corner of the window sill, jumped up, stretched out her arms, and grabbed the eaves of the roof. Then she exerted force on her arms, pulling her whole body upward, and her upper body lifted from the sky.Peeking out from the holes in the flower board.
Just when Su Xiao was about to check the situation outside, a crisp sound came.
"Bang."
It was a gunshot, a dull gunshot, and Su Xiao immediately made a judgment.
After retracting her body against the wall and clasping her hands tightly on the wall eaves, Su Xiao slowly poked her head out to check the situation outside.
"Bang, bang, bang..."
Gunshots like exploding beans were heard outside. After Su Xiao's observation, this should be a fight between two groups from the 'Scrap Terminal'.
There were dozens of people on each side, engaged in a mid-range gunfight.
Su Xiao carefully noticed that the clothes of both parties were very shabby, and their faces were sallow and thin. They should be refugees from the 'waste terminal'.
"Toby, this land belongs to us. What do you mean? We are all poor scavengers. Do you want to kill them all?"
The gunfire subsided somewhat and both sides began to argue loudly.
"Your territory? I have more than a dozen guns now. I will have the final say here from now on. When I have saved enough Baileys, I will take people out to sea. At that time, I will be a pirate."
Rogier, put down your weapon, I will give you an opportunity to take refuge... "
Before Toby could finish his words, he was interrupted by the sound of a gunshot and felt his head shrink back behind the mountain of garbage.
Su Xiao, who was in the dilapidated house, could just see the person who was speaking. He was a bearded strong man standing behind a pile of garbage with a grin on his face. It seemed that he did not want to accept the other party's surrender, but wanted to destroy the other party.
This bearded and strong man named Toby is different from those refugees with yellow faces and skinny muscles. This guy is tall and has muscles all over his body.
Su Xiao sighed in his heart, he finally realized how dangerous the world of lv.6 was.
If he had gone out rashly before, he would have been beaten into a hornet's nest, and this was just the beginning, and it should be more dangerous after that.
Just as Su Xiao was waiting for the two groups to disperse, a dexterous figure suddenly jumped from the roof into the house where he was.
"Huh~, it's so dangerous, I finally found a safe place..."
Halfway through the visitor's words, he saw Su Xiao clinging to the wall.
"That..."
Just when the other party was about to speak, Su Xiao had already loosened the hand that was tightly clasping the eaves of the wall, and his body fell freely.
After landing, Su Xiao lowered his body, kicked off the ground, and a few dead leaves flew up. He pounced on the opponent like a nimble cheetah.
The other party just wanted to explain something, but it was too late.
Su Xiao first punched the opponent's lower abdomen. He could clearly feel that the opponent's soft lower abdomen was dented by the fist.
The visitor bent over in pain and was about to scream, but Su Xiao's palm had already covered the other person's mouth and nose, and only a muffled groan came out.
This wasn't over yet, Su Xiao covered the other person's mouth with one hand, and stretched out the palm of the other hand, like a sharp blade, with her fingertips hitting the other person's chest hard.
"Boom." There was a unique muffled sound like a heavy blow to the chest.
Su Xiao could feel that the other party's body softened, and he collapsed with panic in his eyes, and he could only murmur softly.
When her fingertips hit the opponent's heart, Su Xiao felt a very soft touch.
"Woman?"
The reason why he did this was because he couldn't tell whether the opponent was a friend or an enemy, so it was better to subdue him first.
"No~, don't hurt me."
A soft voice like a mosquito came, and Su Xiao looked at the person coming up and down.
The face is unevenly black, and his face is covered with dust, but the cheeks that are not covered by the dust are very fair. The linen-colored clothes are very loose. It can be seen that the other party's body is very thin and he is not old.
"Who are you?"
Su Xiao could guess the other party's purpose, it should be to take refuge.
"My name is Mia. I really don't mean any harm. Please don't hurt me." Mia's voice was very low.
The heart was hit hard, and Mia was considered very strong even if she was not unconscious. In a short period of time, she was unable to move freely.
"Don't say anything, or I'll kill you."
If life is in danger, Su XiaoBut he knows how to kill, and he still has a blood feud that he has yet to avenge.
"Gulu."
Mia, who was only fifteen or sixteen years old, swallowed.
"Okay, I just want to take refuge and won't make any noise."
Mia suddenly felt that staying with the man in front of her was no safer than outside.
The gunfire outside gradually subsided, and the chaos should be over soon.
Su Xiao is waiting. Once the chaos outside ends, he will go out immediately. Although it is dangerous, it is also an opportunity. He needs weapons.
At the beginning, his hands were empty. Not to mention decent weapons, there was not even a wooden stick near Su Xiao.
(Sanqi Chinese et)
